metric_definitions.strict: point-wise precision/recall/F1 over every test timestep
metric_definitions.adjusted: point-adjusted: an event counts as fully detected if any timestep in it is flagged; applied per channel before pooling
metric_definitions.channel_mean: unweighted mean of per-channel metrics (NaN channels ignored)
metric_definitions.pooled: recomputed from confusion counts summed over all channels
metric_definitions.mean_latency: timesteps from event start to first alert inside the event, over detected events
metric_definitions.false_alarms_per_1k: alert runs not overlapping any labelled event, per 1,000 test timesteps
metric_definitions.attribution_hit: injected column ranks top-k by per-feature reconstruction MSE averaged over windows containing the injection; chance = expected rate under a random ranking

attribution.method: argmax of per-feature reconstruction MSE, averaged over windows containing the injection
